    About this item

    • Curved to Perfection - Acer's Nitro EDA343CUR 34" curved panel monitor with Ultra Wide QHD resolution delivers the incredible. Through AMD FreeSync Premium technology, the game’s frame rate is determined by your graphics card, not the fixed refresh rate of the monitor, giving you a serious competitive edge. Smooth, tear-free gameplay!! Crisp, true-to-life colors come alive with the amazing 3440 x 1440 resolution, allowing you to enjoy High-Definition entertainment in the comfort of your home.
    • Quality Visuals - The Nitro EDA343CUR 34" Curved Display with QHD (3440 x 1440) resolution offers the sharpest picture quality and provides a perfect picture with a broader view. The zero-frame design does away with the thick frames found on conventional monitors freeing up precious screen space so you have more to look at from edge to edge.
    • AMD FreeSync Premium Technology - Say “goodbye” to stuttering and tearing. With AMD FreeSync Premium, the monitor’s frames are synced with the graphics card’s frames, which eliminates screen tearing and provide the smoothest gaming experience.
    • Up to 180Hz Refresh Rate - The 180Hz refresh rate speeds up the frames per second to deliver ultra-smooth 2D scenes. With a rapid refresh rate of up to 180Hz, Acer Monitors shorten the time it takes for frame rendering, lower input lag and provide gamers an excellent in-game experience.
    • Responsive!! - Up to 0.5ms GTG (Gray to Gray) response time enhanced gamers’ in-game experience. No matter the fast-moving action or any dramatic transitions will be all rendered smoothly without the annoying effects of smearing or ghosting with EDA343CUR Gaming Monitor.
    • HDR Ready - HDR is a display technology that creates deeper levels of black and white contrast, giving you a greater level immersion through realistic image recreation. The Acer Nitro ED0 series of HDR displays support the HDR10 format.
    • Curved Screen - The curved 21:9 display wraps you in a world of entertainment with every corner of the screen at the same distance from your eyes for a uniform viewing experience without blind spots. Tilt the screen -5 to 15 degrees for the most comfortable view.

    From the manufacturer


    Curved to Perfection

    Acer's Nitro EDA343CUR 34" curved panel monitor with Ultra Wide QHD resolution delivers the incredible. Through AMD FreeSync Premium technology, the game’s frame rate is determined by your graphics card, not the fixed refresh rate of the monitor, giving you a serious competitive edge. Smooth, tear-free gameplay!! Crisp, true-to-life colors come alive with the amazing 3440 x 1440 resolution, allowing you to enjoy High-Definition entertainment in the comfort of your home.

    • 34" UWQHD (3440 x 1440) 1000R Curved VA Widescreen Display
    • AMD FreeSync Premium Technology
    • Refresh Rate: 180Hz (Using Display Port) - 100Hz (Using HDMI Port)
    • Response Time: 1ms (G to G) - Up to 0.5ms (G to G)
    • HDR 10 Support
    • Ergonomic Tilt: -5° to 15° | VESA mounting compliant (100 x 100mm)
    • 2 Speakers, 3 Watts per Speaker
    • Ports: 1 x Display Port 1.4, 2 x HDMI 2.0 Ports & 1 x Audio Out (Display Port and HDMI Cable Included)

    Features

    Quality Visuals

    The Nitro EDA343CUR 34" Curved Display with QHD (3440 x 1440) resolution offers the sharpest picture quality and provides a perfect picture with a broader view. The zero-frame design does away with the thick frames found on conventional monitors freeing up precious screen space so you have more to look at from edge to edge.

    AMD FreeSync Premium Technology

    Say “goodbye” to stuttering and tearing. With AMD FreeSync Premium, the monitor’s frames are synced with the graphics card’s frames, which eliminates screen tearing and provide the smoothest gaming experience.

    Up to 180Hz Refresh Rate

    The 180Hz refresh rate speeds up the frames per second to deliver ultra-smooth 2D scenes. With a rapid refresh rate of up to 180Hz, Acer Monitors shorten the time it takes for frame rendering, lower input lag and provide gamers an excellent in-game experience.

    Features

    Responsive!!

    Up to 0.5ms GTG (Gray to Gray) response time enhanced gamers’ in-game experience. No matter the fast-moving action or any dramatic transitions will be all rendered smoothly without the annoying effects of smearing or ghosting with EDA343CUR Gaming Monitor. .

    HDR Ready

    HDR is a display technology that creates deeper levels of black and white contrast, giving you a greater level immersion through realistic image recreation. The Acer Nitro ED0 series of HDR displays support the HDR10 format.

    Curved Screen

    The curved 21:9 display wraps you in a world of entertainment with every corner of the screen at the same distance from your eyes for a uniform viewing experience without blind spots. Tilt the screen -5 to 15 degrees for the most comfortable view.

    • John
      5.0 out of 5 stars Acer always delivers
      Reviewed in Canada on January 21, 2025
      Verified Purchase
      I've always been an Acer customer, not because of being a loyal fan of Acer, but because i've tried and tested their products and they've been reliable for the past 20+ years of using them. They're not into the most high-end specs as other brands have, in fact they come in simple yet GOOD designs not too tacky unlike other brands.

      Although this is my first Ultrawide monitor from Acer, so far it's been performing good. Eventhough there was an issue on the first item delivered, as it had a Dead pixel, but they sent in a replacement after reporting the issue, and arrived the next day. The replacement monitor so far runs pretty good, like I said their products aren't always to the Extremes like other brand names, but the product does what it does reliably.

      Colors to me are vibrant, compared to the Xiaomi I recently purchased which I will be returning. This monitor is fast and no ghosting or smearing while playing games. No flickers whatsoever, and no dead pixel on this one. Again this is my first VA panel and I heard common issues of VA panels, but so far so good.

      I would highly recommend this product to anyone interested in purchasing a good descent gaming and all-around monitor. If you're an Enthusiast gamer though, I suggest getting a IPS panel or OLED. This monitor is for Average all-around users who enjoy a good HD monitor with some Graphic design/Programming, Research etc. and occasional gaming done to it. It's a good all-around monitor, and a lot of realestate as well in terms of windows management.

      2.0 out of 5 stars It's actually a pretty decent budget monitor, but I had to send it back...
      Reviewed in Canada on August 16, 2025
      Verified Purchase
      This monitor is pretty good. You even have Picture-in-Picture support (that works when HDR is disabled) which I wasn't expecting.

      The biggest issue that lead to me returning it was the fact 2 dead pixels appeared only after a week and a half of usage. I honestly thought it was just some specs of residue on the monitor at first, because how could this happen so fast? I wiped the area with a microfiber cloth, then eventually powered the monitor off, inspected it and that area was actually spotless. I left it unpowered for about 25 minutes and afterward they were still there.

      So off it goes, back to the warehouse unfortunately.

    • Peter Simone
      5.0 out of 5 stars Worked great right out of the box.
      Reviewed in the United States on August 7, 2024
      Verified Purchase
      Picked this bad Larry up on prime day for a great price. Had been wanting an ultra wide for a while and this one hit a good balance of performance and price. I am using it as a primary display for a gaming laptop running a Ryzen 7 and RTX 3070 mobile graphics. It takes a lot of horsepower to render 3440 x 1440 so be aware of that if you have an older GPU but mine keeps up fine for most things. I specifically chose this resolution because 4k would have likely been too much for the system.

      You will need to enable HDR on the monitor itself. This hung me up for a few minutes as I expected this to be enabled by default and it was not. Once this was resolved though the colors were bright and vibrant and the picture is sharp and crisp. Other than that setup was super easy. Stand goes together with like 4 screws and is very simple to adjust. It is also sleek and feels sturdy. The integrated RGB is a nice touch too.

      Outside of gaming, this thing is a dream to do work on. Double wide spreadsheets are great. There’s just so much desktop space to lay out all your open windows.

      Overall very happy with this monitor after the first few weeks. Would recommend to anyone in the market for an ultrawide.
